connector.name: Reel Estate MCP by tryreelestate.com
connector.registryDescription: Turn real-estate listing photos into property videos from your AI assistant.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package reel-estate-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.tryreelestate, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: MCP_SERVER_URL
env.description: Backend origin hosting the /mcp endpoint. Defaults to Reel Estate production (https://api.tryreelestate.com); set to a staging or self-hosted backend to override.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Public OAuth client id (PKCE, no secret). Auto-selected per backend host by default; set only when pointing at a backend on a different Clerk instance.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PORT
env.description: Loopback port the browser is redirected to after sign-in. Defaults to 8765.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_STORE_DIR
env.description: Directory where OAuth tokens are cached. Defaults to ~/.reel-estate-mcp.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE
env.description: Optional OAuth scope override. Omitted by default (negotiated from server metadata).

env.name: MCP_READONLY
env.description: Set to 1/true to block all mutating (non-GET) tool calls.
